integrity: New mathematical proof and separately reproducible finite checks are included; numerical experiments are not used as infinite certificates. Literature priority is conditional on inspected sources.
scientific_limitations: Only continuous-time symmetric nonnegative rates with uniform stationary distribution, total edge-rate budget, and clique with exactly two pendant vertices. Closest discrete-time and tree results use distinct feasible sets. Coverage by inaccessible 2002 work cannot be excluded.
title: A sharp clique-edge activation transition in budgeted lollipop mixing
